name: Subdivide
description: Quartered, then quartered again: a mask that keeps three of every four squares.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); mask: @m(2x2, linear-gradient(@p(#000, #000, #000, #0000) 0 0) calc((@nx - 1) * 100%) calc((@ny - 1) * 100%) / 50% 50% no-repeat); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
